patch_description: This crossover combines the strongest elements from both programs: (1) the beam search with adaptive beam width from the current program (best-scoring phase-1 constructor), (2) the fast full-lookahead greedy with randomized multistart from the inspiration program used to generate additional diverse candidate schedules cheaply within the phase-1 budget, and (3) the time-budgeted simulated annealing with greedy-insertion intensification for phase-2 refinement. Reasoning: beam search explores broadly but each restart uses random seeds; the greedy multistart cheaply produces good, diverse candidates (with tie-breaking for diversification) that seed SA from different basins, improving escape from local minima. SA from multiple starting points with intensification sweeps has proven to drive the makespan down; feeding it both beam candidates and greedy candidates increases the chance one lands near a global optimum.
